cand.title: LeBooster Breakfast Genève – January 2027
cand.excerpt: Medium: exact member networking breakfast; mainly F&B/day-meeting, not guestrooms.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Cassandra Attard is the edition’s named contact and CCIFS Cheffe de projets événementiels; first contact for the breakfast and clarification of purchasing pathways. Laureen Olivieri is Responsable des activités événementielles et des adhésions; relevant escalation for wider event partnerships. Jordan Bagnis is Office manager LeBooster Genève et référent RH; relevant venue-operations contact. None is publicly identified as hotel contracting signatory.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced activity: 19 January 2027, 08:00–09:30 UTC+1, LeBooster Genève, Route de Jussy 35, 1226 Thônex, canton Geneva, Switzerland. This is within the requested horizon. Registration closes 15 January 2027 at 17:00 UTC+1. A separate later edition is announced for 14 September 2027, 08:00–09:30 UTC+2, at the same venue; it does not replace the January target.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using supplied hotel constraints: poor direct fit for January. A free 90-minute breakfast at the organizer’s Thônex premises does not justify a 20–120-room group block in Founex. Historical editions drew about 30 members; no January 2027 total is published. YOTEL’s supplied flexible meeting product could suit a separate La Côte business workshop or offsite, but that is a relationship-development hypothesis, not sourced demand. Resort positioning is irrelevant; this is local business networking. Catering capacity must be checked before any offer.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue confirmed, not an open venue search: LeBooster Genève, Route de Jussy 35, 1226 Thônex (Ge), entrance via Chemin de la Mousse, second floor. Territory: Geneva urban area, specifically Thônex municipality, not Geneva city proper and not Founex/Nyon/La Côte/Geneva Airport corridor. LeBooster is a CCIFS-operated business/coworking centre, not a hotel. The publication proves the selected venue, not a signed contract.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sampled timeline: 16 January 2024 at LeBooster Genève, Route de Jussy 35, Thônex; 28 October 2025 at LeBooster Genève; 2 December 2025 at the organizer’s Thônex business centre; 27 October 2026 at LeBooster Genève, Route de Jussy 35. These establish repeated in-house breakfasts, not annual rotation or an exhaustive edition history. January and September 2027 are also published at the same address.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown; no hotel, housing bureau, booking link, room block or open accommodation RFP is identified on the January edition page. Hotels listed for this edition: none. The event states “Gratuit” and “Sur inscription uniquement. Réservé aux membres CCIFS et résidents LeBooster.” Programme: “09:00 | Café-croissant réseautage” and “09:30 | Fin de l’événement.” These describe a short networking breakfast, not lodging procurement. LeBooster’s separate use of “hébergement” concerns business centres/incubators and company workspace, not delegate guestrooms.
findings.organizationStructure: Event organizer/owner: CCI France Suisse, officially an “association de droit local d’utilité publique, à vocation bilatérale.” Venue: its LeBooster business centre. Delivery contacts are internal CCIFS staff. No external PCO, DMC, agency or housing bureau is identified for the edition.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Primary incumbent is the organizer’s own business centre, not a competing hotel. October 2026 was marked “COMPLET,” but no numeric capacity or overflow procurement is published; sold-out registration is not hotel overflow evidence. Geneva Marriott Hôtel representatives presented as members in January 2024; that is not a host-hotel, room-block or preferred-supplier commitment. No lodging commitment elsewhere is established.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Deprioritize January as an immediate hotel revenue lead. Contact Cassandra Attard first, referencing 19 January, and ask whether any external catering requirement or separately budgeted La Côte meeting exists. Ask Laureen Olivieri about a distinct member workshop/site visit at YOTEL rather than relocating the confirmed breakfast. Confirm membership/guest eligibility before registering. Do not hold guestrooms or prepare an accommodation proposal without a dated overnight requirement; verify catering feasibility before pricing breakfast.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: January registration is free but restricted to CCIFS members and LeBooster residents and requires registration; no public invitation for hotel suppliers to bid. Venue is already selected. Access guidance names “Léman Express : Gare de Chêne Bourg”, buses 32/37 and trams 12/17. No Geneva Airport arrival, La Côte lodging or overnight travel evidence is published. This is neither Lausanne nor French Pays de Gex.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: low capture potential for this established in-house breakfast format. A later 14 September 2027 breakfast is already announced at LeBooster Genève, so recurrence must not be described as an open future tender. More plausible, but unverified, is a separate CCIFS/member-company La Côte workshop or small corporate offsite; no 2028 edition or hotel sourcing brief was located in the reviewed material.
